# möbius for macOS 0.2.7

- Point a message at what's beside it: type @ in the message field to pick an open tab,
  one of the chat's files or a file in the chat's folder. Or right-click a tab, a file
  in the Files tab or a file card in the chat and choose Add to message. Files go in by
  path, web pages by address, and files on your Mac are attached.
- Drag files onto a chat, or paste copied files or a screenshot into the message field,
  to attach them.
- The New tab lists the chat's files: everything you sent the Bot and everything it
  sent back.
- The side panel slides away when you hide it, as smoothly as it slides in.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later. Works with the same gateway (0.15.53,
protocol 86) as 0.2.0 through 0.2.6.
